script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

**Title:** The Healing Garden

**Logline:** In the midst of a bitter legal battle, two estranged siblings unexpectedly reunite at their late mother's garden, discovering the power of forgiveness and healing.

---

**FADE IN:**

**INT. COURTROOM - DAY**

JUDGE (60s, stern) presides over a packed courtroom. SIBLING A (40s, determined) and SIBLING B (40s, defensive) face each other.

JUDGE
The court finds in favor of Sibling A. Sibling B must relinquish control of the family estate to Sibling A.

SIBLING B
(angrily)
I'll appeal this decision.

**EXT. FAMILY ESTATE - DAY**

A month later, Sibling A arrives at the estate to take possession. They find the garden, their late mother's pride and joy, in disarray.

**INT. ESTATE HOUSE - NIGHT**

SIBLING A (to themselves)
Mom would never want this place to be a battleground.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 2)**

The next day, Sibling A starts to clean up the garden. LOCAL GARDENER (50s, kind) approaches.

LOCAL GARDENER
(smiling)
You're not from around here. Your mother's garden was famous.

SIBLING A
(sighs)
I've inherited the estate. I plan to restore it.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 3)**

As Sibling A works on the garden, Sibling B arrives, unannounced.

SIBLING B
(angrily)
What are you doing?

SIBLING A
(calmly)
Trying to bring order to our mother's garden.

SIBLING B
(fuming)
That's not your property anymore.

**INT. ESTATE HOUSE - DAY**

They argue over the garden and the estate.

SIBLING A
(frustrated)
Why are we fighting over this? We both want what's best for the family.

SIBLING B
(defiant)
You want it all! I just want a piece of our mother's legacy!

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 4)**

As they continue to argue, a FAMILY FRIEND (60s, wise) arrives.

FAMILY FRIEND
(to both siblings)
Your mother would want you to stop this senseless fighting. She'd want you to forgive each other and heal the wounds of the past.

SIBLING A
(pauses)
You're right. I've been focused on winning this battle, but what's truly important is our family.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 5)**

SIBLING A extends an olive branch to Sibling B, who hesitantly accepts. They work together to restore the garden.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - NIGHT (Scene 6)**

As they work, they share memories of their mother and start to understand each other's perspectives.

SIBLING B
(apologetically)
I've been so focused on what I thought was best for the family. I didn't consider how my actions would affect you.

SIBLING A
(forgivingly)
And I've been too stubborn, too focused on winning. We've both made mistakes.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 7)**

The siblings continue to restore the garden, working together and supporting each other.

**INT. ESTATE HOUSE - NIGHT (Scene 8)**

They sit down to talk about the future of the estate and how they can work together for the betterment of their family.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 9)**

As they work on the garden, they start to bond over their shared memories and experiences.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 10)**

The garden begins to flourish, symbolizing the healing of their relationship.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 11)**

They invite their extended family and friends to see the restored garden, which brings them all closer together.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 12)**

As the siblings work together to maintain the garden, they begin to rebuild their family bonds.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 13)**

They hold a dedication ceremony for their late mother, thanking her for the gift of the garden and the lessons it has taught them.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 14)**

As the siblings continue to work on the garden, they find peace and closure, knowing that their relationship is stronger than any legal battle.

**EXT. HEALING GARDEN - DAY (Scene 15)**

The camera pans out as the siblings work side by side, their faces filled with love and forgiveness, as the garden represents the healing of their family.

**FADE OUT.**

---

**THE END.**
